# Linktree

1 endpoint, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 1 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

<!-- BEGIN:GENERATED:ENDPOINTS (auto-generated by generate-docs.ts - AIP-16b) -->

## GET /v1/linktree/page - 1 credit (standard)

Get Linktree page

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 900s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Author · **Pagination** none

Returns data from a Linktree page including the user's display name, bio, avatar, and list of links with titles and URLs.

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Full URL of the Linktree page · e.g. `https://linktr.ee/charlidamelio`

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/linktree/page?url=https://linktr.ee/charlidamelio" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
